Enabled.name: Enabled
Enabled.definition: Account can be used for its intended purpose.

Disabled.name: Disabled
Disabled.definition: Account cannot temporarily be used for its intended purpose.

Proforma.name: Proforma
Proforma.definition: Account is temporary and can be partially used for its intended purpose. The account will be fully available for use when the account servicer has received all relevant documents.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: Status is a bilaterally agreed status.

ClosedStatus1Rule.definition: If Closed is present then Enabled is not allowed.

EnabledDisabledStatus1Rule.definition: If Enabled is present, then Disabled is not allowed.

EnabledDisabledStatus2Rule.definition: If Disabled is present, then Enabled is not allowed.

ClosedStatus3Rule.definition: If Closed is present then Pending is not allowed.

ClosedStatus2Rule.definition: If Closed is present then Disabled is not allowed.

ClosedStatus4Rule.definition: If Closed is present then PendingOpening is not allowed.

ClosedStatus5Rule.definition: If Closed is present then Proforma is not allowed.

ClosedStatus6Rule.definition: If Closed is present then ClosurePending is not allowed.

StatusElementRule.definition: One of the elements (Enabled, Disabled, Pending, PendingOpening, Proforma, Closed, ClosurePending, Other) must be present.
